capabilities: Apply Novel Mode editing features to notes tagged mode: novel
Insert and render ruby and emphasis dots in four notations
Register, highlight, and insert story terms from glossary notes
Export cleaned manuscript text via customizable cleaning rules
extras: Mobile support documented per feature with explicit limitations; author reports testing only on physical iOS devices, with Android and tablets unverified. Requires Obsidian v1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks Japanese manuscript conventions such as ruby notation, vertical text, paragraph indentation, full-width space handling, and manuscript-paper character counting.
summary: Japanese novel-writing toolkit that adds Novel Mode editing with ruby, term highlighting, vertical-text preview, cleaning-rule export, and writing stats.
